submitted.rationale: XRD shows a mixed Nb-V oxide phase (peaks at Q≈1.05, 1.39, 1.45, 1.55, 1.80) from Nb 0.46 to 0.62. It is absent at Nb 0.71, where a different minor phase appears; the strong 1.87/2.63/3.54 peaks common to all samples look like substrate. Photocurrent rose steadily toward the V-rich end: -3.17e-6 A at Nb 0.71 (idx 13), 6.26e-6 A at Nb 0.505 (idx 11), and 8.56e-6 A at Nb 0.456 (idx 4). Index 4 is the most V-rich candidate in the library and had the highest measured merit.

rejected.reason: Nb-rich (0.71), a different phase, negative photocurrent (-3.17e-6 A)
Not measured. The trend of more V giving more photocurrent suggests they fall between idx 13 and idx 11
